task:
SWITCH EVERY EXECUTABLE BASE-IMAGE PULL FROM public.ecr.aws TO THE ghcr.io MIRROR.

Context: .github/ci-image-mirror.txt maps each public.ecr.aws/docker/library/<name>:<tag>[@sha256:<digest>] source to ghcr.io/brianstewart377-rgb/ed-finder/mirror/<name>:<tag>[-pin-<digest12>]. The CI base-image mirror workflow has populated every entry (run 39063526759: all 12 copied with digests preserved and verified; all packages pull anonymously). Anonymous public.ecr.aws pulls keep failing CI with 'toomanyrequests: Data limit exceeded'.

Do this:
1. Replace every executable reference (workflows under .github/workflows, docker-compose*.yml, every Dockerfile* under apps/, scripts/dev/review_lab/lifecycle.py, scripts/rehearsal/v3_derived_purge_rehearsal.py, and any other .py/.sh/.yml that pulls or runs one) as follows:
   - floating public.ecr.aws/docker/library/<name>:<tag>  ->  ghcr.io/brianstewart377-rgb/ed-finder/mirror/<name>:<tag>
   - pinned public.ecr.aws/docker/library/<name>:<tag>@sha256:<d>  ->  ghcr.io/brianstewart377-rgb/ed-finder/mirror/<name>:<tag>@sha256:<d>  (keep the SAME digest; keep the tag for readability; Docker resolves by digest). Do NOT change any digest.
   - prefix constants such as ECR_PUBLIC_LIBRARY_PREFIX = 'public.ecr.aws/docker/library/' in scripts/dev/review_lab/lifecycle.py and _DOCKER_LIBRARY_MIRROR in tests/test_container_image_parity.py: point them at 'ghcr.io/brianstewart377-rgb/ed-finder/mirror/' and rename the identifier sensibly (e.g. CI_IMAGE_MIRROR_PREFIX), updating all uses.
   Leave docs/ and CHANGES.md history untouched except where a current runbook tells someone to pull from public.ecr.aws (update those).
2. Keep .github/ci-image-mirror.txt as the source list (its left column stays public.ecr.aws, which is the mirror's upstream). Every ghcr mirror reference used anywhere must correspond to a list entry: add a contract test in tests/test_ci_image_mirror.py that (a) fails if any executable file outside .github/ci-image-mirror.txt, docs/ and CHANGES.md contains public.ecr.aws, and (b) fails if any ghcr.io/brianstewart377-rgb/ed-finder/mirror/<name>:<tag>[@digest] reference is not produced by a list entry (floating: destination tag equals; pinned: same name, same tag prefix, and the digest equals that entry's pinned digest). Remove or adapt the existing test_every_executable_public_ecr_reference_is_mirrored accordingly (the adjacent-literal join for .py files must stay).
3. Update every existing test that asserts the old public.ecr.aws strings (e.g. tests/test_container_image_parity.py, tests/test_v3_web_release_image.py, tests/test_review_lab_v3.py, tests/test_backup_restore_ops.py, tests/test_v3_application_checkpoint_release.py, tests/test_v3_decommission_contract.py, tests/test_migration_script_contracts.py and any other) to assert the mirror references instead, without weakening what they check (bare 'postgres'/'redis'/'nginx' images must still be refused).
4. Production release images: apps/api/Dockerfile.release and apps/web/Dockerfile base images change registry only; digests unchanged, so built images stay byte-identical. If tests/test_v3_application_checkpoint_release.py or the accepted-release attestation pin Dockerfile hashes, recompute only what the repository's own tools derive and say so in the commit message.
5. Add a CHANGES.md entry (2026-10-17, newest first) describing the switch.

Run ruff, actionlint on all workflows, and pytest for every touched test file plus tests/test_ci_image_mirror.py tests/test_ci_stall_detection.py; `python scripts/operator/v3_production_deploy.py --operation authority-gate` must report failures []. Do not dispatch any workflow.
